description: Active in-stock product on the store that a given product or category promotion discounts (listed in its products, or in its category). KB: Configuring a Promotion (Find Product, Find Category); Discount Distribution Workflow (line item discounts).

productType.description: Product type the test adds: simple, configurable, bundle or grouped

promotion.description: Promotion code (ZnodePromotion.PromoCode) of the resolved promotion or coupon key in the same test

quantityUsed.description: Highest quantity the test sets for this product in the cart

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

minMaxQuantity.description: Optional: the product must allow at least this quantity in the cart (MaximumQuantity >= value); left out = any maximum

maxPrice.description: Optional upper bound (exclusive) on the unit price, e.g. so a cart stays under another promotion's minimum order; left out = any price above zero

belowOrderMinimum.description: Optional: promotion order minimum (e.g. @promotion.orderMinimum): unit price x max(1, minimumQuantity) below it, unit price x MaximumQuantity (when numeric) at or above it

minimumQuantity.description: Optional: the quantity the test starts the line at for the belowOrderMinimum check (e.g. @promotion.minimumQuantity); left out = 1. Used only with belowOrderMinimum
